);

module gp(
    input [1:0] g,
    input [1:0] p,
    input c_in,
    output g_out,
    output p_out,
    output c_out
);
    assign g_out = g[1] | (p[1] & g[0]);
    assign p_out = p[1] & p[0];
    assign c_out = g[0] | (p[0] & c_in);
endmodule

module add(
    input a,
    input b,
    input c,
    output g,
    output p,
    output s
);
    assign g = a & b;
    assign p = a | b;
    assign s = a ^ b ^ c;
endmodule
